unit: S81-02 held fragrance juices (zero network) + corpus fragrance PDP field presence

key_definition.key: brand|line|concentration = fields 2-4 of app/services/spec_spine_service.py::spine_key(brand, line, None, 'fragrances') (the ml field is dropped); imported, pure function
key_definition.brand_split: spine_key needs brand and name separately and the held sources carry one free-text string; the brand is the longest entry of the documented BRANDS list in scripts/held_fragrances.py matching the start of the string (case-insensitive); unmatched strings get brand '' (brand_resolved false)
key_definition.side_split: a 'A vs B' query contributes both sides; a single-product query contributes itself
key_definition.concentration_absent: '-' when the text names no concentration (spine_key convention); the same line with and without a concentration is two keys
key_definition.tag: keys measured by the repo function; the brand split is a documented normalisation

distinct_juice_count.unit: distinct brand|line|concentration keys across the four sources

fragrance_by_index_flag.definition: sweep2 row is_fragrance == True (recorded by the 2026-08 sweep)

fragrance_by_content.definition: inferred: the <title> head (before the first ' | '), og:title, the URL path or a JSON-LD Product name carries a concentration phrase (price_service.extract_concentration), a perfume word (EN/FR/ES/PT/PL perfume|parfum|cologne|woda perfumowana|woda toaletowa|perfumy|profumo, or the Arabic word for perfume), or an ml/oz/Arabic-ml size token together with a FRAGRANCE_BRAND_KEYWORDS brand; recall is imperfect (a fragrance page naming none of these, e.g. a bare line name, is missed)

global.index: sc-scraper-proof/_proof/global/_corpus_cachemap.json (328 rows; corpus.json n_rows 328), html = each row's _cache_path

fragrance_by_content.definition: as gulf fragrance_by_content (the global corpus has no is_fragrance flag)

corpora.blocked_split: unblocked_subset drops pages the corpus index records as blocked (gulf: structurally_blocked or status != 200; global: blocked or http_status != 200)

field_definitions.jsonld_product: a parseable application/ld+json block holds a node typed Product/ProductGroup/IndividualProduct/ProductModel
field_definitions.jsonld_name: a non-empty name on such a node or a hasVariant child
field_definitions.jsonld_brand: brand as a non-empty string, or a dict/list carrying a non-empty name
field_definitions.jsonld_image: image as a non-empty string, or a dict url/contentUrl, or a list holding one
field_definitions.jsonld_offers_price: offers (dict or list, nested offers / priceSpecification included) with price/lowPrice/highPrice parsing to a number > 0
field_definitions.size_in_title: the page <title> carries a number + ml / fl oz / oz / Arabic-ml token
field_definitions.tag: measured from the cached HTML bytes, zero network
